about: A modest influence map of territorial variables for Necoclí. Analyst synthesis of the two 2026 listening reports. Polarity: '+' = the two variables move in the same direction; '-' = opposite directions. No weights, no simulation. Links come from report statements, never from administrative API interconnections. Loops are shown only where both directions are stated in the source.
